title: On Bullsh*t Jobs | David Graeber | Meaningless Jobs | Royal Society of Arts | Lecture
summary: David Graeber's RSA lecture on bullshit jobs, expanding on his essay about why so many people do work they believe is pointless. He discusses what this says about the modern economy and the way society values work.
why: Used as a reference when discussing meaningless work and bureaucracy growth in tech and management.
